content: Academic release checklists (Imageomics Code Checklist, Zenodo FAIR Code Publishing roadmap, KU Leuven FAIR software, UCSB Research Data Services, GEO-InQUIRE FAIR training, NCCR Exit Strategy) converge on: LICENSE (MIT/Apache permissive for code, CC-BY for data; 'without a license your software cannot be legally reused'), README with installation + end-to-end reproduction commands, requirements.txt/pyproject.toml with pinned versions, .gitignore, CITATION.cff (cff-version 1.2.0, ORCID) or BibTeX, scripted (not manual) data preprocessing, set seeds, relative paths only, documented hardware requirements, semver tags, Zenodo DOI archival of releases (GitHub is not preservation), and license/attribution clarity for external data sources.
